name: useQueryParamTableState
description: A hook that syncs data table state (pagination, sorting, filters) with URL query parameters for shareable and bookmarkable table states.
usage_guidelines: Use for tables where state should persist in URL.
Enables shareable links with specific table state.
Automatically parses query params into table state.
Separates paging state from custom filter state.

params.name: initialTableData
params.description: Default table state when no query params present.

return_value.type: {pagingState: TableQueries, filterState: Record<string, string>, setQueryParams: Function}
return_value.description: Object containing parsed table state and setter function.

pagingState.description: Parsed pagination and sorting state from URL.

setQueryParams.description: Function to update query parameters. Override replaces all params.

Dont: Don't store sensitive data in URL
Don't forget to handle invalid params
